title: Mixing TObject and IInterface references on the same instance double-frees it
notes:
Classic Delphi ARC trap: an instance referenced by BOTH a raw
TObject pointer and an IInterface gets its refcount confused. When
the TObject reference calls Free directly, the still-live interface
reference will release a freed instance on scope exit. Migration
targets (C# / Java) do not have this footgun, so the spec MUST flag
it AND surface the migration policy (always-use-IDisposable, never-
mix-references) as an open question. Calibrated against the
decade-old Indy bug http://bugs.indyproject.org/ticket/130 (the
original reference was 'mixing IInterface and TObject in TIdSocketHandle').
